_comment: T-473 Vault of the First Hollowing raid boss 3 — the First Hollowing, the Hollow King (graduation fight, 10-man; drops the T-353 anchor relic itm_maldrath_hollow_crown on the weekly table). Instance-scoped via data/instances/hollow_vault.json. Skeletal-warrior silhouette at 1.8 (he TOWERS over Maldrath's 1.6 — Maldrath was patient zero; this is what hollowed him). T-332 'phase_summon' chassis re-statted for 10: HP (50+180*5)*36 = 34,200 -> ~117s at RAID_DPS 293 (a 5-party needs 207s it cannot survive). Melee 30*4.0 = 120/swing / 2.4s = 50 dps tank intake; phase 2 at 50% enrages x1.4 (70 dps) and doubles shade summons (cap 4, ~32 dps raid-wide) -> ~102 intake: under a raid's 165 hps, roughly double a 5-party's 55 — the wall the entry gate mirrors.
lore: T-473 (era-direction.md S2): Maldrath was only the first body. What crowned itself in the deepest vault is the Hollowing's own beginning — kill it and Era 1's outbreak has an author, if not an end.
name: The Hollow King
